description.value: Milano's Ristorante is a long-established Italian and Mediterranean restaurant in North Nanaimo, founded by the Mavrikos family whose restaurant roots stretch back to 1974 in Victoria. Specialising in house-made pizza, pasta, and Greek-influenced dishes with fresh daily preparation, it has earned a loyal local following over more than two decades under the Milano's name. A partnership with the nearby Avalon Cinema Complex for 'Dinner and a Movie' packages adds a distinctive local character.
